youtube.caption:
A Greek philosopher laughed so hard at his own joke that he died 💀

What's the funniest way YOU'D want to go? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Chrysippus, head of the Stoic school in Athens, died around 206 BC at 73. Diogenes Laërtius records that he saw a donkey eat his figs, told the old woman to give it neat wine to wash them down, and laughed so hard he died. (Diogenes also gives a second version: dizziness after drinking undiluted wine.) He is said to have written 705 works.
